chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan, from Abdullah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Ali (peace be upon him) ruled regarding a slave-girl whose husband had divorced her with two divorces, then had sexual relations with her, so he flogged him.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a husband who has relations with his slave-girl after giving her two divorces?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* records Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) juridical ruling that a husband who consummates marriage with his slave-girl after two divorces must be flogged, highlighting the distinct legal status of enslaved women in early Shia jurisprudence. This ruling underscores the principle that while a man may retain his slave-girl without a formal third divorce, consummation triggers a specific corporal punishment, differentiating her case from that of free women where three divorces are required for re-marriage.
